name: Human owner acceptance binds exact content and supports account-bound replay
summary: A signed-in project owner accepts exact current requirements content in simple mode without operator membership. Native decisions bind account/project/governance, revision and content hash; replay rechecks live authority. Confirmed decision bindings survive interrupted evidence writes; missing bindings remain unknown and cannot fabricate success. The page offers reload and Accept, or edit a legacy draft and accept its new revision. Validated native attribution for the current pending wording appears beside Accept, including after a governance mode switch; actor spelling does not establish account identity. Returned acceptance evidence names the accepted revision and hash even after a later draft. Raw evidence is reserved; governed and machine credential policies remain unchanged. Backup/restore retains bindings.
